title: Anotación de Foto de Outfit de Moda: Pantalla de Teléfono en Primera Persona con Etiquetas de Marca y Precio
prompt: A first-person perspective photograph of a hand holding a smartphone, showing a fashion outfit photo on its screen. The phone screen displays a full-body shot of a young woman with a ponytail in a park, wearing a grey puffer jacket, a beige cutout turtleneck, a white skirt, and black boots. Handwritten white text and arrows on the screen point to each item with brand names and prices in Japanese Yen (e.g., "しまむら ¥5,980", "ユニクロ ¥2,290"). The phone's camera app interface with a shutter button is visible. The background behind the phone is a slightly blurred autumn park with a wooden bench and fallen leaves.
